Topical preparations containing an imidazole such as ketoconazole or miconazole, usually with hydrocorti- sone, are used in the management of seborrhoeic dermatitis (p.1584). A cream containing miconazole nitrate 2% and ben- zoyl peroxide 5% has been used topically in the treatment of acne (p.1577).
